title: The Copper Press
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Ghent, 1473. Apprentice printer Margriet van der Meer inherits her master's copper press — and his secret: the press can print in color, a secret worth killing for, because the color reveals a map that the Church has spent a century erasing. Margriet must decide what a woman with a press and a truth can print, and what it will cost her.
